description: A server-side Fabric dev tool for Minecraft 1.21.10 that prevents opening loot containers and displays their loot table keys via title screen.

mods.name: Loot Table Peeker
mods.description: A server-side developer tool that stops loot containers from opening, showing their loot table id or a rerollable preview of the loot instead.
